Sets allowance and then invokes an arbitrary spender contract, enabling reentrancy.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts to reject ETH.
onlyOwner rescue function that makes an arbitrary external token contract call.
External callback entrypoint defined by ApproveAndCallFallBack and invoked on arbitrary spender contracts.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, balance ownership and allowances.
Addition c = a + b inside safeAdd, protected by require(c >= a).
Subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub, protected by require(b <= a).
Multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul, protected by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Division c = a / b inside safeDiv, protected by require(b > 0).
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply; can underflow in unchecked Solidity 0.4.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) executed before state settlement; reentrancy vector.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to a user-supplied token contract.
Unconditional revert() in the payable fallback.
